purpose: Teach: 劣っ/裏返し/裏腹/正しかっ/小柄/可愛らしい/起っ/つくれ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、体力で劣ってる分、頭で勝負しろ
lines.en: Riku, you're weaker physically — so beat me on brains instead.
lines.style: Direct challenge, almost teasing. Quick attack on the first syllable. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone who's thought about this and wants him to know she believes he can do it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノートを裏返しに書いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were writing in your notebook upside-down, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry observation delivered soft but pointed. Small smile underneath. Not accusatory — more like he's noticed something she didn't realize she was showing. Quiet, steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、笑顔と裏腹に悩んでたな
lines.en: Riku, underneath that smile you were worried about something.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle. Not a question — a statement of something truly seen. Slower pace. Slight pause before the observation, like she's choosing her words carefully. No judgment in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、あの時の判断が正しかったぞ、桜
lines.en: Your call back then — it was the right one, Sakura.
lines.style: Firm but tender conviction. Light emphasis on 「right」. Looking straight at her. The reassurance of someone who's thought it over and arrived at certainty. Not trying to convince, just telling her what he knows.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、小柄だけど運動神経すごいな
lines.en: Riku, you're smaller but your reflexes are incredible.
lines.style: Casual admission of something true. Slight brightness underneath — not quite praise-seeking, more like stating a fact she respects. Warm, straightforward. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、妹さん可愛らしいな、桜
lines.style: Gentle, genuine. Said almost to himself, like the observation slipped out. Warm but not overplayed. The tone of someone comfortable enough to say something kind without performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家の近くで事故が起ったって聞いたぞ
lines.en: Riku, I heard there was an accident near your house.
lines.style: Shift to serious. Slower, more careful. The opening is gentler — concern underneath the words. Not leading, just checking in. Like she's giving him space to respond or deflect.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、模型をつくれる才能あるな、桜
lines.en: You've got real talent for building models, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm recognition, offered plainly. Steady voice, no oversell. The compliment lands because it's specific and genuine. Small pause before the name — like he's making sure she hears it.
